name: Kazumi
source:
Yukinari's older ex-girlfriend whom he dated for almost two years while he was in middle school. After her suicide attempt, she and her family moved away for a change of pace and she started to see a therapist regularly. This proved to be very positive for her, but it was only a few years later-at the end of the game- that she finally plucked up the courage to send a letter to Yukinari, formally apologizing for the abuse that she put him through. While the two will never be as close as they once were, they've patched things up and still send each other letters from time to time. She is doing well in Hokkaido and goes on to work as a kindergarten teacher.

[From in-game bio]
